title: Trade Finance Manager
description:
**The Trade Finance Lead in Business Treasury Operations is responsible for overseeing the entire Trade Finance Operation, managing overall liquidity, and ensuring adherence to related compliances. The Trade Finance Lead must possess a high level of proficiency in planning, enabling timely and accurate communication of the company's financial overall working capital position to various stakeholders.** 




  





**Educational Qualification:** 




**CA / MBA (Finance) / ICWA / Inter CA / CFA or equivalent in Financial Management.** 




  





**Work Experience:** 



* **Minimum of 10\-12 years of experience in operations, or a related field, with at least 3\-4 years in a middle level leadership role.**
* **Must have knowledge and experience in Banking operations, Trade Finance, Capital Finance and MIS \& Compliance.This includes managing the issuance and administration of Letters of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantees (BG), Acceptance, and Buyers Credit.**
* **Extensive experience in trade finance functions, including expertise in managing day to day requirements of LC / BG / BC / Vendor Finance etc., as well as ensuring rigorous governance and compliance related to trade finance operations.**
* **Ensure the maintenance of efficient processes by managing the issuance and administration of Letters of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantees (BG), Acceptance, and Buyers Credit and Vendor Financing.**
* Ensure operations perform within TAT and undergo frequent checks for process effectiveness, enabling near real\-time accounting in line with excellence standards.
* Drive continuous process audits to ensure operational excellence and adherence to best practices.
* Identify gaps in trade finance processes and implement best\-in\-class solutions for improved efficiency and cost reduction. Promote automation and AI\-driven solutions to streamline trade finance processes, MIS for the business team, and audit schedules, as well as efficient working capital management, forecasting, and end\-to\-end month closing activities.
* Ensure stakeholder alignment and engagement through regular meetings, governance forums, timely escalations, and performance reporting. Drive the development of a system infrastructure that enables near real\-time visibility of trade finance operations for key stakeholders, including CFOs, business units, and treasury teams.



  





**Prospects from a Infrastructure / Manufacturing / Finance Industry with extensive experience In Trade Finance operation can connect at joy.saha@adani.com OR 9898791075**

title: General Manager – Finance & Accounts (Taxation, Audit & Compliance)
description:
**Role Objective:** 




 Key objective of this role is to lead the group's accounting, taxation, audit and compliance function across all Indian and overseas entities of Biotech Healthcare Group, ensuring robust financial processes and strong internal controls.
 



  





 The role is responsible for delivering a clean, reconciled trial balance every month across all subsidiaries; preparing quarterly consolidated financial statements; owning the annual statutory audit with Big 4 auditors; building a robust internal audit and internal financial controls (IFC) framework, including plant and operational process audits; and ensuring full global regulatory and tax compliance.
 



  





 The position will lead a team of \~20 across accounts, taxation and internal audit, and will serve as the company's key interface with statutory and internal auditors, tax consultants and government revenue departments (Income Tax, GST, FEMA and Customs), ensuring a clean compliance track record for the group.
 



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Education** 




**Minimum:** 



* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).



**Desirable:** 



* Additional certification in IFRS (e.g. DipIFR) or Internal Audit / Controls (e.g. CIA, CISA).



  





**Experience Requirement** 




**Minimum:** 



* 12–15 years of post\-qualification experience in accounts, taxation, audit and compliance.
* Experience of handling Big 4 statutory audits from the company side – audit readiness, schedules, queries and timely sign\-off.
* Experience of managing financial processes across subsidiaries – timely accounting, monthly closure with clean trial balance and preparation of quarterly consolidated financial statements (P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on SAP experience.



**Desirable:** 



* Big 4 background – trained at a Big 4 firm.
* Experience in a multi\-entity manufacturing group, preferably in pharma / healthcare / medical devices.
* Exposure to overseas group entities and global / group\-level compliance.



  





**Role Requirements** 



* Strong experience in group accounting, monthly close and consolidation across multiple entities.
* Deep working knowledge of Companies Act, Ind AS / IFRS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, EXIM, FEMA and Customs, along with IFC requirements.
* Hands\-on experience in internal audit, internal financial controls and plant / operational process audits in a manufacturing environment to identify leakages and gaps.
* Proven experience of dealing with government revenue departments – tax assessments, scrutiny notices, appeals, hearings and refunds.
* Track record of automating controls and processes in SAP.
* Strong team leadership, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work with auditors, consultants, authorities and senior management.



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



1. Deliver a clean, reconciled trial balance for every group entity and subsidiary each month.
2. Prepare quarterly consolidated financial statements for the group (P\&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow) in line with Ind AS / IFRS.
3. Lead financial processes across the group – timely accounting, process controls, a standardised close calendar, reconciliations and intercompany accounting.
4. Own the group's annual statutory audit with Big 4 auditors end to end – audit readiness, schedules, queries and timely sign\-off.
5. Build a robust internal audit programme with the in\-house Internal Audit team and externally appointed auditors; strengthen internal financial controls (IFC) and close audit findings on time.
6. Roll out uniform internal audit standards and checks across all group entities.
7. Automate all major controls across the group in SAP to ensure there are no leakages.
8. Conduct plant and operational process audits across manufacturing facilities to identify leakages, gaps and inefficiencies, and drive corrective actions to closure.
9. Ensure full compliance with Companies Act, Ind AS / IFRS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, EXIM, FEMA and Customs across the group.
10. Manage tax audits and assessments, both direct and indirect.
11. Oversee compliance of overseas group entities in coordination with local advisors.
12. Represent the company before Income Tax, GST, FEMA and Customs authorities for assessments, scrutiny notices, appeals, hearings and refunds; coordinate with tax consultants and counsel, and maintain a clean track record with the departments.
13. Lead, develop and review the accounts, taxation and internal audit team, building capability and succession cover for key positions.
14. Report key compliance, audit and financial\-close status to the Financial Controller and senior management on a regular basis.



  





**Functional Skills Required** 



* In\-depth knowledge of group accounting, monthly close, intercompany accounting and consolidation.
* Expertise in statutory audit management with Big 4 auditors.
* Strong understanding of Companies Act, Ind AS / IFRS, GST, TDS, Income Tax, EXIM, FEMA and Customs requirements.
* Expertise in internal audit, IFC design and testing, and plant / operational process audits.
* Experience in handling tax assessments, notices, appeals and refunds with revenue departments.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI/CO) and automation of controls and processes.



  





**Behavioral Skills Required** 



* Strong team leadership, with the ability to lead and develop a team of 20\+ including Chartered Accountants.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* High integrity, ownership and accountability for timelines and compliance.
* Analytical thinking with attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management with auditors, consultants, authorities and internal teams.
* Determination and keen interest in the role.



  





**Team Size to be Handled:** 



* \~20 team members, including 3–4 Chartered Accountants, across accounts, taxation and internal audit. Reporting to the Financial Controller.

title: Credit Analyst | Fixed Income
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Analyst to join our Fixed Income. The role will be responsible for evaluating credit opportunities, conducting detailed financial and business analysis, assessing issuer creditworthiness, and providing insights to support investment and transaction decisions across the fixed\-income portfolio.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct detailed credit analysis of corporates, NBFCs, financial institutions and other debt issuers.
* Analyse financial statements, cash flows, leverage, liquidity, profitability, capital structure and debt\-servicing capability.
* Evaluate bonds, NCDs, structured debt, private placements and other fixed\-income instruments.
* Prepare comprehensive credit appraisal notes, issuer profiles, investment memos and transaction analyses.
* Assess credit risks, industry dynamics, business risks, financial risks and promoter/management strength.
* Analyse existing and proposed debt structures, security cover, collateral, guarantees, covenants and repayment mechanisms.
* Conduct financial modelling, ratio analysis, sensitivity analysis and stress testing.
* Monitor issuer performance, financial results, rating actions, industry developments and other material credit events.
* Track and analyse credit ratings, rating rationale and rating\-agency reports.
* Provide independent views on credit quality, risk\-return considerations and suitability of debt opportunities.
* Support evaluation of new issuers and identify potential investment / transaction opportunities.
* Work closely with debt capital markets, sales, dealing, investment, risk, legal and compliance teams for transaction evaluation and execution.
* Participate in management/issuer discussions, due diligence and credit review meetings.
* Prepare investor presentations, credit briefs, teasers and other transaction\-related materials.
* Maintain ongoing monitoring reports and early\-warning indicators for existing exposures.
* Keep abreast of interest rates, credit spreads, bond yields, regulatory developments and macroeconomic trends impacting fixed\-income markets.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of Credit Analysis and Fixed Income markets.
* Good knowledge of debt instruments, bond structures, credit ratings, covenants and security mechanisms.
* Strong ability to analyse financial statements and assess creditworthiness.
* Excellent financial modelling and analytical capabilities.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance and capital structure.
* Ability to interpret rating\-agency reports and industry research.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to form independent analytical views.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, transaction\-oriented environment.



  





**Preferred Experience : 2 to 5 Years** 




 Candidates with experience in Credit Research, Fixed Income, Investment Banking, Credit Rating Agencies, Banks, NBFCs, Asset Management or Corporate Finance will be preferred.
 



  





**Educational Qualification** 




 CA / CFA / MBA / PGDM – Finance / relevant financial qualification from a reputed institution.
 



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Quality and depth of credit assessments
* Accuracy of financial and credit analysis
* Timely completion of credit notes and investment evaluations
* Effective identification of credit risks and early\-warning signals
* Quality of issuer and industry research
* Contribution to sound fixed\-income investment and transaction decision

title: Deputy Manager- Cost Estimator
description:
**Position\- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager \- Cost Estimator** 




**Location\- Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Location may change based on business needs)** 




**Company Reputed Infra \& RE company with 3000\+ employee strength** 




**Department\- Green Energy Division** 




**﻿** 




**About Patel Infrastructure ​** 




**​** 
 Patel Infrastructure Limited (PIL) brings more than 5\+ decades of experience in the infrastructure sector and has built a strong execution track record across 5\+business verticals. Each of these verticals has an average annual turnover of \~INR 3,000 crore, reflecting the company’s scale, financial strength, and capability to execute large and complex infrastructure projects.​
 



 ​
 



 Patel Greentech is subsidiary company of PIL, currently executing 0\.70 GW Solar and 1\.3 GWh BESS and 0\.20 GW Wind projects and has a planned rollout of 3 GW Renewable Energy and 5 GWh BESS over the next three years. Our focus is on reliable, cost\-optimized, and sustainable power solutions for energy\-intensive industries.
 








**Position Overview:** 




 The Cost Estimator will be responsible for developing accurate and reliable product and manufacturing cost estimates. The role will focus on material costing, product costing, BOM, manufacturing process costing, labour, machine cost, wastage, utilities, overheads, standard versus actual cost analysis and cost optimization.
 



  





 The position requires a combination of business understanding, technical knowledge, financial awareness, and strong analytical capability to support cost\-effective product and manufacturing operations.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.    Product Costing** 



* Prepare detailed costing for power cables based on approved designs, specifications and BOMs.
* Calculate material consumption, wastage and yield for copper, aluminium, insulation, screens, fillers, armour, sheathing and other components.
* Calculate product cost on metre, kilometre and batch basis.
* Maintain and update standard product costs based on approved material prices.
* Review costing for new and modified cable products.



  





**2\.    Manufacturing Costing** 



* Develop process\-wise manufacturing costs for drawing, stranding, compaction, insulation, screening, cabling, armouring and sheathing.
* Calculate machine\-hour rates, labour, utilities, consumables, tooling and manufacturing overheads.
* Establish and maintain standard process times and cost parameters.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify key cost drivers.



  





**3\.    BOM, Routing \& ERP** 



* Prepare and maintain accurate BOMs, manufacturing routings and costing data.
* Coordinate with Design, Engineering and Production to validate product structures and manufacturing requirements.
* Review standard BOM consumption against actual production consumption.
* Maintain costing\-related master data and revisions in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics.



  





**4\.    Cost Analysis \& Control** 



* Analyse Standard Cost vs. Actual Cost after production.
* Identify material, labour, machine, scrap, utility and overhead variances.
* Investigate significant cost deviations and identify root causes.
* Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Stores and Finance for corrective actions.
* Prepare periodic product costing and variance reports.



  





**5\.    Cost Optimisation** 



* Identify opportunities for material and manufacturing cost reduction.
* Support Design\-to\-Cost and Value Engineering initiatives.
* Evaluate alternative materials, designs and manufacturing processes.
* Improve material yield, reduce scrap and optimise machine utilisation.
* Track and quantify savings from approved cost\-reduction initiatives.
* Ensure cost optimisation does not compromise product quality or applicable standards.



  





**6\.    New Product \& Process Costing** 



* Prepare preliminary and detailed costing for new cable products.
* Support Engineering and Production during product development and trials.
* Compare estimated cost with actual trial\-production cost.
* Assess the cost impact of design, material and process changes.
* Update standard costing based on validated production data.



  





**7\.    Costing Systems \& Process Improvement** 



* Develop and maintain standard costing templates, models and processes.
* Maintain historical cost data and costing benchmarks.
* Improve costing accuracy, consistency and turnaround time.
* Review actual procurement and production costs against standard estimates.
* Identify opportunities to improve the costing methodology and systems.



  





**8\.    Cross\-Functional Coordination** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and external business partners, including Design \& Engineering, Production, Procurement, Quality, Finance, suppliers, vendors, and contract manufacturers
* Provide costing inputs for product development, pricing and profitability analysis.
* Communicate cost assumptions, variances and recommendations to management.
* Take ownership of assigned costing activities and deliver within agreed timelines.
* Guide junior team members in costing activities, where applicable.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Education \& Experience** 




 ·      Bachelor’s degree in electrical / supply chain management/ economics/ finance/ operations/ engineering, or a related area.
 


* Minimum of 3 to 8 years work experience in cost estimation, product costing, manufacturing costing, purchasing management, buying, or commodity management.
* Experience in power cables, wires \& cables, electrical equipment or related manufacturing industries preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience in BOM costing, material consumption, process costing, machine\-hour rates, wastage/yield and manufacturing overheads.
* Experience in Standard Cost vs. Actual Cost analysis, cost variance and cost optimisation.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP / Oracle / Microsoft Dynamics and advanced MS projects.
* Experience in new product costing, product development and manufacturing cost analysis will be an advantage.
* Independently managing costing activities and coordinating with cross\-functional teams is preferred.
* CMA / ICWA with relevant manufacturing\-costing experience is added advantage.
* Minimum Travel required based on Business requirement



  





**Key Competencies** 



* **Industry Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of cable construction, materials and manufacturing processes.
* **Costing:** 
 Strong knowledge of BOM, material consumption, process costing, wastage, labour and overheads.
* **Manufacturing:** 
 Understanding of cable manufacturing processes and production economics.
* **ERP:** 
 Experience with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or similar ERP systems.
* **Analytical Skills:** 
 Ability to analyse cost variances and identify cost drivers.
* **Cost Optimisation:** 
 Ability to identify practical material and process cost\-reduction opportunities.
* **Commercial Awareness:** 
 Understanding of material pricing, procurement costs and product profitability.
* **Coordination:** 
 Effective communication with cross\-functional teams.
* **Ownership:** 
 Accuracy, accountability, timely delivery and continuous improvement.

**Job Purpose:** 
 The TCD Site Executive (OPEX) is responsible for overseeing the procurement and inventory management of OPEX items required for operational activities across all mining sites. The role ensures the timely and cost\-effective acquisition of goods and services, maintaining optimal inventory levels to support continuous site operations.

**Category In\-charge (CAPEX) \- NR**
****Strategic Procurement And Supplier Management:****
 Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.
   

  

 Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost\-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.
   

  

 Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.
   

  

 Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
   

  

**Inventory Management:**
 Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.
   

  

 Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.
   

  

 Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.
   

  

 Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.
   

  

 Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.
   

  

**Financial And Budget Management:**
 Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.
   

  

 Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.
   

  

 Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.
   

  

 Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.
   

  

**Operational Coordination And Reporting:**
 Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.
   

  

 Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.
   

  

 Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.
   

  

 Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.
   

  

 Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.
   

  

 Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.
   

  

 Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX\-related procurements and inventory.
   

  

 Release all e\-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.
   

  

 Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.
   

  

 Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.
   

  

**Compliance And Quality Assurance:**
 Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.
   

  

 Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.
   

  

 Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.
   

  

**Technology Integration:**
 Deploy digital tools for real\-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.
   

  

 Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Sites Projects team
   

  

 Marketing department
   

  

 Finance \& Accounts team
   

  

 Quality Assurance Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Vendors
   

  

 Suppliers
   

  

 External agencies
   

  

 Auditors
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
 Strategic Sourcing:
   

  

* Plan and forecast Capex procurement needs based on the projects in pipeline and organization's strategic objectives.
* Formulate contractual terms and conditions for major EPC contracts to secure favorable terms.
* Negotiate with vendors for long\-term contract terms to ensure beneficial agreements.
* Select the bidding process, prepare vendor selection approaches, and vendor evaluation criteria to streamline the procurement process.
* Review RFI and RFP documents, identify potential bidders, and organize pre\-bid meetings to facilitate a competitive bidding process.
* Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations and fact\-based negotiations/e\-auctions to select the best vendors.
* Review Notes for Approval (NFA) for selected bidders and obtain required approvals to ensure compliance with company policies.
* Leverage extensive experience in mining and material handling procurement, including handling mining and EPC contractors, explosives, CHPP, and project monitoring to develop and implement procurement strategies.


**Core Procurement Activities:**
* Understand the Techno\-Commercial strategy and plan for the Business Unit (BU) to implement strategic initiatives for all categories (Group\-wide/BU specific) as per plan.
* Oversee the review of approved PRs from user departments to ensure correctness and completeness of PRs.
* Coordinate with leads in identifying the type and method of procurement based on material/service type, urgency, stock availability, rate contracts, value, and delivery timeline to optimize procurement efficiency.


**Contract Management:**
* Oversee the preparation of contract documents as per protocols and standard templates to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Set up approved contract records within the ERP system to maintain accurate and accessible records.
* Maintain contract documents for future reference and compliance to ensure traceability and accountability.
* Collate Advance Bank Guarantee/Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (ABG/CPBG)/Customs related documents from vendors to secure financial assurances.
* Prepare, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved NFAs to secure long\-term pricing agreements.
* Prepare master outline agreements in ERP systems based on rate contracts to streamline procurement processes.
* Prepare PO/SO for procurement under valid rate contracts to facilitate timely procurement.


**Supplier Management:**
* Oversee the identification of vendor evaluation criteria in consultation with quality, engineering, and project management departments to ensure rigorous vendor selection.
* Ensure completeness of forms submitted by vendors and update the approved vendor list to maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date vendor database.
* Coordinate with new vendors for evaluation documents and with quality/engineering/user teams for assessments if required to ensure comprehensive vendor evaluations.
* Prepare vendor segmentation matrices and performance evaluation criteria to categorize and assess vendor performance effectively.
* Oversee the evaluation process for CapEx and services vendors, ensuring thorough review of vendor scorecards.
* Plan improvement actions for vendors with unsatisfactory performance to enhance vendor performance.
* Manage all cluster CAPEX commercial activities and site TC functions as per Delegation of Authority (DoA) to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.


**Data Management And Risk Management:**
* Collate and analyze data related to large scale procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) to derive actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Identify procurement risks for assigned categories using master lists, supply market analysis, long\-term procurement plans, annual procurement plans, and project risk registers to mitigate risks.


**People Management:**
* Work towards achieving set goals and participate in performance reviews to stay aligned with team objectives.
* Communicate personal development needs and actively engage in creating and following Individual Development Plans (IDP) for professional growth.
* Develop skills in current and future functional focus areas as per the capability matrix and IDP guidelines to contribute to team versatility.


**Technology Integration:**
* Utilize digital solutions for comprehensive tracking and analysis of capital expenditure projects, ensuring accurate forecasting and budgeting.
* Implement digital tools for project management and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency in Capex initiatives.
* Contribute to action planning and implementation based on data analytics to enhance CAPEX procurement strategies.

**Work Experience (Range of years):**
**Work Experience (Range Of Years):**
 More than 12 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement.

title: E-Commerce Accountant
description:
**E\-Commerce Accountant** 

  





**Company:** 
  Ginn Techlabs
 



**Location:** 
  On\-site
 



**Experience:** 

  3–4 Years
 




  




**About Us** 


 At Ginn Techlabs, we're building the next generation of AI\-powered personal assistants that combine modern web technologies, scalable cloud infrastructure, and intelligent backend systems. Our mission is to create products that simplify complex workflows through intuitive, intelligent, and delightful user experiences.
 




  




**1\. Job Description** 


 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical
 
**E\-Commerce Accountant** 

 to manage our high\-volume multi\-channel financial operations and platform accounting. In this role, you will oversee marketplace reconciliations, inventory valuations, payment gateway settlements, and tax compliance across our e\-commerce platforms and digital channels. You will play a crucial role in closing month\-end books, analyzing channel profitability, and setting up automated financial workflows to support our growing product ecosystem.
 




  




**2\. Key Responsibilities** 
* **Marketplace \& Gateway Reconciliations:** 

 Resolve multi\-channel lump\-sum payouts (e.g., Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal) against bank records by matching aggregate deposits to order IDs, credit cards, and customer accounts.



  




* **Fee, Deduction \& Expense Booking:** 

 Track and itemize channel\-specific expenses, including referral fees, payment processing charges, FBA/logistics costs, performance marketing, advertising, and promotional offer expenses.



  




* **COGS \& Inventory Valuation:** 

 Track real\-time Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and value stock across multiple warehouses/fulfillment centers using FIFO or Weighted Average inventory valuation methods.



  




* **Returns \& Claims Accounting:** 

 Accurately record customer returns, Return to Origin (RTO) logistics, stock write\-offs, held reserves, and chargeback dispute adjustments in the general ledger.



  




* **Tax Compliance (GST/TDS/Sales Tax):** 

 Manage GST classification, destination\-based sales taxes, TDS/TCS filings, Input Tax Credit (ITC) optimization, and cross\-border customs or duties across multi\-jurisdictional channels.



  




* **Automation \& Integration:** 

 Configure and maintain automated e\-commerce accounting connectors (e.g., A2X, Synder) between order management systems (OMS), marketplace platforms, and primary accounting software.



  




* **Receivables \& Vendor Management:** 

 Perform regular vendor reconciliations, handle distributor/customer payment knock\-offs, manage credit controls, and track aging receivables.



  




* **Financial Reporting \& Analytics:** 

 Parse large CSV exports to generate channel\-wise profitability statements, margin breakdowns, cash flow projections, and month\-end closing reports.



  




**3\. Required Skills** 
* **Experience:** 

 3–4 years of accounting experience with mandatory exposure to e\-commerce or multi\-channel sales operations.



  




* **Education / Certification:** 

 Degree in Accounting/Finance (B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance) or CA Inter.



  




* **Tax \& Statutory Compliance:** 

 Hands\-on experience with GST compliance, GSTR returns (GSTR\-1, 2, 3B), ITC reconciliations, TDS, and financial regulations.



  




* **Financial Software Proficiency:** 

 Proficiency in SAP, Tally, QuickBooks, or similar core ERP/accounting platforms.



  




* **Data \& Spreadsheet Mastery:** 

 Advanced MS Excel skills with the ability to handle high\-volume data, parse CSV exports, and build detailed financial statements.



  




* **Core Accounting Mechanics:** 

 Strong working knowledge of double\-entry bookkeeping, general ledger entries, vendor/customer reconciliations, and receivables management.



  




* **Accounting of App Subscriptions:** 

  Direct expertise in revenue recognition, deferred revenue tracking, recurring billing reconciliation, and platform commissions for in\-app purchases and SaaS/app subscription models.



  




**4\. Preferred Skills** 
* Professional certifications such as CPA, ACCA, CMA, or CA Inter.



  




* Prior experience working within a Direct\-to\-Consumer (D2C) brand, FMCG, retail, or an AI/Tech\-driven product company.



  




* Experience with cross\-border e\-commerce transactions, multi\-currency conversions, and international tax laws.



  




* Familiarity with inventory management systems (IMS/OMS) and automated accounting connectors (A2X, Synder).



  




* Strong cross\-functional coordination skills (Sales, Digital Marketing, Channel Management, and Logistics teams).



  




* Strong attention to detail, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to meet tight month\-end closing deadlines.



  




**5\. Tech Stack** 
* **Accounting \& ERP Systems:** 

 SAP, QuickBooks, Tally, NetSuite, Xero.



  




* **E\-Commerce \& Payment Platforms:** 

 Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Flipkart, and native web portals.



  




* **Automation Connectors:** 

 A2X, Synder, and automated IMS/OMS integrations.



  




* **Data \& Productivity Tools:** 

 Advanced MS Excel / Spreadsheets, Cloud Accounting tools, and custom CSV data parsers.

title: US Tax Manager - International Tax & Advisory, K C Mehta & Co LLP · Ahmedabad · Full-time
description:
**About us** 




 K C Mehta \& Co LLP is a firm of chartered accountants founded in 1958, with offices across India and in the UAE. We advise Indian and multinational groups on tax, transfer pricing, transactions, assurance and business advisory. Our international practice serves clients across the India–US corridor: Indian groups investing in the US, US businesses with operations in India, and US\-resident individuals with assets and income in India.
 



  





**The role** 




 We are looking for a US Tax Manager to lead our US tax work. This is an advisory role first. We want someone who can identify the issue, research it, write the memo, explain the answer to a client's CFO, and stand behind the recommendation, while also overseeing the compliance that follows from it. You will work closely with the partners, our transfer pricing and transactions teams, and clients in the US.
 



  





**Who will you report to** 




 Dhaval Trivedi, Partner, Corporate \& International Tax
 



  





**What you will do** 




**Advisory** 



* Advising Indian groups on US expansion, including choice of entity, check\-the\-box elections, capitalization and financing, effectively connected income exposure, and profit repatriation.
* Advising US groups with Indian / overseas operations (other jurisdictions) on Subpart F, GILTI (NCTI), FDII (FDDEI), foreign tax credits and BEAT, including the effect of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act changes on existing structures.
* Applying the India–US tax treaty and other tax treaties that US has with various countries to live fact patterns, including permanent establishment, withholding rates, limitation on benefits and treaty\-based return positions.
* Supporting cross\-border acquisitions, restructurings, flips and reverse flips with tax due diligence and structuring advice, working with our transactions team.
* Working with our transfer pricing team on intercompany arrangements and their effect on US tax positions.
* Advising US\-resident individuals and families on Indian assets and income, including foreign information reporting, PFIC exposure and cross\-border estate and gift planning.



  





**Compliance and review** 



* Reviewing corporate, partnership and individual returns with international content, including Forms 1120, 1120\-F, 1065, 1040, 5471, 5472, 8858, 8865, 8621, 1116, 1118, 8938, 3520, 3520\-A and FBAR.
* Reviewing withholding compliance, including Forms 1042 and 1042\-S and FIRPTA.
* Supporting clients through IRS notices and examinations.



  





**Engagement leadership** 



* Running engagements day to day, including scoping, timelines, deadline tracking, budgets and client communication across time zones.
* Reviewing the work of the team and building a US tax bench through training and coaching.
* Keeping clean engagement files, including engagement letters, contemporaneous documentation, taxpayer consents and data\-security procedures for US taxpayer information.



  





**Practice building** 



* Contributing to proposals, client presentations, articles and webinars on US and cross\-border tax.
* Building relationships with US accounting firms, law firms and other referral sources.



  





**What you bring** 



* 4 to 6 years of US tax experience, of which at least 2 years in international tax, gained in a Big 4 or national firm, a US tax practice in India, or a tax advisory firm.
* A US CPA license or Enrolled Agent status. Candidates who are Chartered Accountants with the relevant US tax experience and are pursuing the CPA or EA will also be considered.
* A track record of advisory work, not only compliance: research memos you have written, structuring recommendations you have made, and client conversations you have led.
* Strong research skills using primary sources and standard US tax research platforms.
* Clear writing and the ability to turn technical analysis into a recommendation a client can act on.
* Willingness to work some hours overlapping with the US business day.



  





**An advantage, not a requirement:** 
 knowledge of Indian direct tax, FEMA or transfer pricing, and experience with India\-connected clients.

title: Manager, Internal Audit
description:
**Job Description**
**SOX 404 Compliance, Control Design and Testing (approximately 60–70%)**
 Plan and execute assigned activities within the Company’s SOX 404 compliance program, ensuring work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with internal methodology and external\-auditor expectations.
   

  

* Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs): Maintain and update RCMs for relevant business processes and IT applications. Confirm that risks are appropriately addressed, control descriptions are clear and complete, and changes in processes, systems, ownership, or risk are reflected promptly.
* Walkthroughs and scoping: Conduct process and control walkthroughs, assess annual scope and key\-control coverage, document process flows, and identify changes that may affect control design or testing strategy.
* Business\-process controls: Evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of controls across key cycles, including Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Financial Close and Consolidation, Human Resources and Payroll, Property, Plant and Equipment, Treasury, Inventory, and other in\-scope processes.
* IT application controls (ITACs): Identify and test automated and semi\-automated controls within enterprise applications, including automated calculations, workflow approvals, three\-way matching, system configurations, and interfaces between internal systems and external service providers.
* Key reports and information produced by the entity (IPE): Identify reports, queries, spreadsheets, and other information used in control performance. Test completeness and accuracy through report logic, parameters, configuration, source\-to\-output reconciliation, access, change management, and, where applicable, SQL or code review.
* Testing and documentation: Prepare clear, complete, and reproducible workpapers that document procedures performed, evidence examined, samples selected, conclusions reached, and reviewer follow\-up. Record testing results and findings in the designated audit and SOX management system.
* Deficiency evaluation and remediation: Identify control gaps, perform root\-cause analysis with stakeholders, assess deficiency severity in accordance with the Company’s framework, agree practical remediation actions, monitor milestones, and retest completed remediation.
* External\-auditor coordination: Act as a primary point of coordination for assigned SOX areas, facilitate walkthroughs and evidence requests, resolve questions, and maintain alignment on scope, testing status, deficiencies, and remediation.
* Control\-owner training: Provide onboarding and periodic refresher training to control owners and performers on control objectives, evidence standards, documentation requirements, and changes to the SOX program.


**Business\-Process Audits, Systems and Advisory (approximately 30–40%)**
* Business\-process and operational audits: Support risk assessments, develop audit programs, perform interviews and testing, analyze root causes and business impact, and prepare practical recommendations. Assignments may cover financial, operational, compliance, technology\-enabled, and cross\-functional processes.
* Audit reporting and communication: Prepare concise status updates, findings, risk statements, and recommendations for management reports and presentations. Maintain regular communication with process owners, Internal Audit leadership, IT, and external auditors; escalate significant issues or delays promptly.
* Issue follow\-up: Maintain accurate records of open actions, validate remediation evidence, confirm sustainable closure, and report overdue or unresolved matters to appropriate stakeholders.
* Control advisory and continuous improvement: Advise stakeholders on process and control improvements while preserving Internal Audit independence. Promote standardized, efficient, and sustainable controls that comply with Company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Data analytics: Use data analysis to identify unusual transactions, process exceptions, control failures, operational bottlenecks, and indicators of error or potential fraud.
* Use of AI: Use Company\-approved AI and audit\-automation tools to support audit planning, SOX control testing, evidence analysis, workpaper preparation, and identification of control gaps. Validate all AI\-generated outputs against source evidence, apply professional judgment and human oversight, and comply with the Company’s confidentiality, data\-privacy, information\-security, and responsible\-AI requirements.
* Other assignments: Support investigations, inventory cycle counts, year\-end physical counts, and other Internal Audit priorities as assigned. Travel to Company locations is required.

* Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) CA \- Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) ICWA \- Preferred
* Master Degree (MBA) MBA \- Preferred


**Experience:**
* 12 years or more in 12 \- 15 Years

title: Senior Manager - Regulatory and Commercial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Power Limited (APL):** 
 Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This role is responsible for managing billing processes, revenue, and payment collection by ensuring accurate and timely updates on various portals, responds to disputes, and provides detailed financial reporting.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Lead \- Commercial (ERCG)**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
 Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
   

  

 Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
   

  

 Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
   

  

 Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
   

  

 Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
   

  

 Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
   

  

**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
 Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
   

  

 In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
   

  

 Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
   

  

 Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
   

  

 Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
   

  

**Portal Management**
 Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
   

  

 Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
   

  

 Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
   

  

 Enforce restrictions on short\-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
   

  

 Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
   

  

**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
 Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
   

  

 Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
   

  

 Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
   

  

**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
 Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
   

  

 Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
   

  

 In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Finance Team
   

  

 Corporate Affairs Team
   

  

 Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) Team
   

  

 Fuel Management Team
   

  

 Power Sales Team
   

  

 Business Development (BD) Team
   

  

 ABEX Team
   

  

 Commercial Controller Team
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 DISCOMs/Procurers
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.
   

  

**Preferred Industry**
 Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

description:
**About the Company:** 




 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Lead Controller \- Financial Reporting, Close and Audit will serve as the primary accounting lead for the Company's monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes. This individual will coordinate and review the close, prepare consolidated financial information, oversee audit support, and ensure that accounting work is complete, accurate, well documented, and delivered on schedule. The role is hands\-on and requires an experienced accounting professional who can review detailed work, identify unsupported or unusual balances, resolve issues, and communicate clearly with the Chief Financial Officer, accounting personnel, and external auditors. Final accounting judgments, SEC accountability, treasury strategy, tax strategy, and executive\-level communications remain with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Close and Consolidation** 




 • Own and administer the monthly, quarterly, and annual close calendar, including deadlines, dependencies, responsibilities, and escalation points.
 



 • Coordinate close activities across the Company's legal entities, business units, and accounting resources.
 



 • Review journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and supporting schedules.
 



 • Ensure all material balance\-sheet accounts are reconciled, supported, and reviewed each reporting period.
 



 • Identify and resolve unexplained balances, aged reconciling items, classification errors, duplicate entries, and other accounting discrepancies.
 



 • Maintain discipline over period close, reopening periods, late entries, and post\-close adjustments.
 



 • Maintain a complete, organized, and audit\-ready electronic close binder.
 



**Financial Reporting** 




 • Prepare and review consolidated balance sheets, statements of operations, statements of cash flows, and related supporting schedules.
 



 • Prepare monthly management reporting packages and clear explanations of material financial\-statement variances.
 



 • Review reported results for unusual trends, period\-over\-period inconsistencies, margin anomalies, and potential accounting errors.
 



 • Maintain the chart of accounts, financial\-statement mapping, consolidation structure, and reporting hierarchy.
 



 • Prepare financial\-statement and footnote support for quarterly and annual SEC filings.
 



 • Perform or coordinate financial\-statement, disclosure, and XBRL tie\-outs and maintain supporting workpapers.
 



**Technical Accounting Support** 




 • Research U.S. GAAP requirements applicable to Company transactions and accounting matters.
 



 • Prepare initial technical accounting analyses and memorandum drafts for Chief Financial Officer review.
 



 • Identify transactions requiring additional accounting analysis, documentation, or external consultation.
 



 • Support accounting for revenue recognition, leases, inventory, stock\-based compensation, discontinued operations, impairments, contingencies, acquisitions, divestitures, and other relevant matters.
 



 • Assist with implementation of new accounting standards and updates to accounting policies.
 



 • Escalate material, unusual, or judgmental accounting matters promptly.
 



**Audit and Quarterly Review Support** 




 • Manage detailed coordination of the annual audit and quarterly review processes.
 



 • Maintain the auditor request list, assign responsibility for requested items, and monitor completion.
 



 • Review schedules and supporting documentation before submission to the external auditors.
 



 • Coordinate responses among accounting personnel, operating teams, and external service providers.
 



 • Track proposed adjustments, passed adjustments, control observations, and unresolved audit matters.
 



 • Identify recurring audit issues and coordinate corrective actions with responsible personnel.
 



 • Escalate potential reporting delays or unresolved audit matters to the Chief Financial Officer.
 



**Internal Controls and Team Coordination** 




 • Maintain financial\-close and financial\-reporting controls, including evidence of preparation and review.
 



 • Maintain accounting policies, close procedures, review checklists, control documentation, and reporting workpapers.
 



 • Identify control failures, documentation deficiencies, and recurring process breakdowns and coordinate remediation.
 



 • Provide day\-to\-day coordination and review of the Accounting Operations Controller and other outsourced accounting resources.
 



 • Maintain an open\-items list covering unresolved accounting, reporting, audit, and control matters.
 



 • Establish clear expectations, review work for quality and completeness, and escalate issues early with recommended solutions.
 



 • Improve documentation and cross\-training to reduce key\-person dependency.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a closely related field.
 



 • CPA, Chartered Accountant, ACCA, or comparable professional accounting designation.
 



 • At least 10 years of progressive accounting and financial\-reporting experience.
 



 • Prior experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Financial Reporting Director, Audit Manager, or comparable accounting leader.
 



 • Direct experience supporting a U.S. publicly traded company and working within a public\-company reporting calendar.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and experience preparing or reviewing consolidated financial statements.
 



 • Experience with multi\-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany eliminations.
 



 • Experience supporting Forms 10\-Q and 10\-K, including financial\-statement and disclosure support.
 



 • Experience working directly with external auditors in a PCAOB audit environment.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to review reconciliations, identify accounting problems, and drive issues to resolution.
 



 • Strong technical accounting research, written documentation, and English communication skills.
 



 • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with ERP and financial\-reporting systems.
 



 • Ability to supervise and review the work of remote accounting personnel.
 



 • Ability to provide meaningful recurring work\-hour overlap with U.S. Central Time, with expanded availability during close and reporting periods.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Prior public accounting experience with a national or regional accounting firm.
 



 • Experience in inventory\-intensive distribution, foodservice, retail, e\-commerce, logistics, or a related industry.
 



 • Experience remediating audit findings, significant deficiencies, material weaknesses, or other internal\-control issues.
 



 • Demonstrated success improving the accuracy, timeliness, or predictability of a financial close.
 



 • Experience implementing or optimizing an ERP, consolidation platform, close\-management system, or financial\-reporting tool.
 



 • Experience supporting acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, discontinued operations, or other complex

title: Income Auditor
description:
**Job Role \- Income Auditor (or Revenue Auditor)** 




  





**A specialized financial professional responsible for verifying, monitoring, and auditing all incoming revenue streams within an organization to ensure accuracy, compliance, and control against financial leakage.** 




  





**The role is vital in the hospitality, where revenue originates from multiple point\-of\-sale (POS) terminals, front\-desk transactions, dining outlets, and online booking engines.** 




  





**Core Responsibilities** 




  





**·       Daily Revenue Reconciliation:** 
 Cross\-check daily sales reports, credit card settlements, point\-of\-sale (POS) terminal receipts, and cash deposits against system postings (e.g., Opera PMS, Micros, or custom enterprise software).
 



 ·       
 **Audit of Room Rates \& Allowances:** 
 Verify room rates, package allocations, complimentary services, discounts, and manager allowances against established company approval matrixes and yield management policies.
 



 ·       
 **Cash \& Banking Control:** 
 Reconcile cash collector envelopes, petty cash reimbursements, foreign currency conversions, and daily bank deposits.
 



 ·       
 **Tax Compliance \& Filing:** 
 Audit applicable taxes (such as GST or local occupancy taxes) charged on services to ensure accurate billing and tax ledger posting.
 



 ·  
 **Discrepancy Investigation:** 
 Identify, report, and correct mis\-postings, unexplained overages/shortages, uncollectible city ledger accounts, or unauthorized rate overrides.
 



 ·       
 **Audit Trail Reporting:** 
 Prepare and distribute the Daily Revenue Report (Flash Report) to senior leadership, department heads, and financial controllers.
 



  





**Key Competencies \& Qualifications** 




**\-     Technical Skills** 
 \- Advanced Excel, PMS/POS software proficiency, ERP ledger navigation, revenue reconciliation
 



 \-     
 **Analytical Ability** 




**\-     Local tax regulations** 
 (e.g., GST rates across service tiers), cash\-handling control frameworks
 



  





**Typical Daily Workflow** 




**1\.   Morning Verification: Retrieve night audit reports, daily POS summaries, and payment gateway settlement files from the previous business day.** 




**2\.   Reconciliation \& Matching: Cross\-verify credit card batch settlements against bank deposits and front\-office cashier receipts.** 




**3\.   Allowance \& Rate Audit: Audit all guest folios containing rate adjustments, voids, or complimentary vouchers to confirm authorized signatures.** 




**4\.   Variance Resolution: Flag posting errors to relevant department heads (Front Office, Food \& Beverage, Operations) for corrective entry.** 




**5\.   Daily Reporting: Generate and issue the finalized Daily Income Report for management review.**

title: Supply Chain Planning Lead – T-FIT
description:
Zotefoams plc is a global leader in advanced cellular materials, trusted by some of the world’s most recognised brands to deliver high‑performance solutions.
   

  

 We design and manufacture lightweight, high‑quality foam products that support innovation across sectors including sports and leisure, aviation, automotive, medical and industrial applications. Alongside our core materials business, we develop and commercialise patented technologies and deliver specialist insulation systems for complex, high‑value environments.
   

  

 This is an exciting time to join Zotefoams. We are growing internationally, investing in our people, technology and capabilities, and seeing increasing demand for our products across global markets. Our work sits at the heart of innovation, helping customers push boundaries in performance, sustainability and design.
   

  

 We offer the chance to be part of a collaborative, forward‑thinking organisation where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contribution has real impact on a global scale.
   

  

**About the Role\~**
 This is a key role responsible for coordinating demand, supply, inventory and production planning across our internal and external supply chain.
   

  

 You will translate sales forecasts and customer requirements into clear, achievable supply plans, working closely with production, procurement, logistics and commercial teams. You will help improve planning discipline, provide greater visibility of risks and support the business in meeting its customer service, revenue and inventory objectives.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced planning professional who enjoys bringing structure to a growing business, working across multiple functions and using data to support effective decisions.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities\~**
* Supporting the development and delivery of demand, supply and inventory planning processes for the T\-FIT business.
* Coordinating regular demand and supply reviews, ensuring assumptions, constraints, risks and actions are clearly captured.
* Translating sales forecasts and customer requirements into practical supply and production plans.
* Working closely with production sites, procurement, logistics and commercial teams to align supply with demand.
* Maintaining accurate planning data, assumptions and key system inputs.
* Monitoring inventory and product availability, identifying risks relating to customer service, excess stock and working capital.
* Identifying capacity constraints, material risks and planning gaps that could affect monthly supply or revenue.
* Producing clear planning reports and updates covering demand, supply, inventory, service and forecast accuracy.
* Improving data quality, planning discipline and adherence to agreed processes.
* Escalating risks and trade\-offs clearly, supported by practical recommendations.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of planning processes, reporting and ways of working.


**What you'll need\~**
* At least five years’ experience within supply chain planning, demand planning, production planning, manufacturing, logistics or a related role.
* A good understanding of demand, supply, inventory or production planning principles.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, spreadsheets, enterprise resource planning systems and planning reports.
* The ability to turn commercial forecasts and customer requirements into realistic operational plans.
* Clear communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders across commercial, manufacturing, procurement and logistics teams.
* Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage changing priorities.
* The confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, identify risks and recommend appropriate action.
* This role involves regular communication with stakeholders across the UK, Europe, USA and Asia, therefore strong spoken and written English is essential.


**It would be beneficial if you also have**
* A degree or professional qualification in supply chain, business, engineering or a related subject.
* Experience with sales and operations planning, sales and operations execution, material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning processes.
* Experience working within an international or multi\-site manufacturing business.


**Why Join Us?**
 Zotefoams is growing fast, investing globally and winning in new markets. This is a chance to be part of a business where things are moving, decisions are made quickly, and your work has real impact.
   

  

 You won’t be a small cog here. You’ll have the space to take ownership, contribute ideas and see them through. We back our people to develop, step up and build long term careers, supported by a team that works together and delivers.
   

  

**Our Values**
**Courage** 
 – We challenge, act and push for better.
   

  

**Impact** 
 – We focus on what matters and deliver results.
   

  

**Respect** 
 – We value different perspectives and work as one team.
   

  

 Zotefoams is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
   

  

 Zotefoams is a world leader in cellular material technology. Using a unique manufacturing process with environmentally friendly nitrogen expansion, Zotefoams produces lightweight foams in Croydon, UK and Kentucky, USA for diverse markets worldwide. These markets include sports and leisure, storage and protection, automotive, aviation and space, railway, healthcare, building, marine and the military.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O\&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 This position is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end management of contracts, ensuring efficient collections, maintaining compliance, managing LC processes, coordinating commercial operations, and facilitating financial transactions while fostering customer satisfaction and adherence to contractual terms.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 He will lead the end\-to\-end commercial function for a large\-scale coal trading business, ensuring seamless execution of domestic and international coal transactions. The role is responsible for contract management, Letter of Credit (LC) operations, trade finance, documentation, commercial risk management, customer and supplier settlements, statutory compliance, shipment execution, MIS reporting, and process automation. The incumbent will play a critical role in safeguarding commercial interests, , mitigating contractual and financial risks, and driving operational excellence across the coal value chain.
   

  

* Commercial Strategy \& Business Governance
* Lead the commercial operations function for domestic and international coal trading businesses.
* Develop commercial strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives and market dynamics.
* Ensure adherence to corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and internal control frameworks.
* Contract Management \& Commercial Risk
* Lead drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of coal procurement and sales contracts.
* Evaluate and approve contract terms relating to pricing, quantity, quality specifications, payment terms, delivery conditions, penalties, and force majeure provisions.
* Identify commercial, contractual, legal, and operational risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Ensure compliance with Incoterms, international trade regulations, and corporate contracting standards.
* Manage contract deviations, amendments, claims, disputes, arbitration matters, and contract closures.
* Coordinate with Legal, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams for contract governance and compliance.
* Letter of Credit (LC) \& Trade Finance Management
* Oversee opening, amendment, negotiation, and closure of Domestic and International Letters of Credit.
* Ensure timely receipt of customer LCs and issuance of supplier LCs as per contractual requirements.
* Review LC clauses for compliance with UCP 600, ISBP guidelines, banking regulations, and contractual obligations.
* Drive LC discounting, bill negotiation, collection arrangements, and trade finance optimization.
* Liaise with banks for LC confirmation, discounting, acceptance, reimbursement, and settlement processes.
* Monitor bank guarantees, performance guarantees, standby LCs, and other trade finance instruments.
* Manage discrepancies in shipping and banking documents to ensure timely realization of funds.


**Documentation \& Shipment Execution**
* Ensure preparation, verification, and control of all trade\-related documentation.
* Ensure timely document presentation for payment realization and shipment release.


**Receivables, Collections \& Working Capital Management**
* Drive collection of customer receivables within agreed credit terms.
* Monitor exposure limits, debtor aging, credit utilization, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure timely collection of cargo value, premiums, penalties, interest charges, and logistics\-related recoveries.
* Strengthening commercial controls to prevent revenue leakage and financial exposure.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, suppliers, banks, and strategic stakeholders.
* Drive service excellence and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Lead and manage cross\-functional commercial teams.
* Develop high\-performance culture through coaching, mentoring, and capability development.


**Others**
**Key Stakeholders Internal:**
* Marketing
* Operations
* Finance and accounting
* Legal
* Logistics
* Customs


**Key Stakeholders External**
* 
* Customers
* Suppliers/ Vendors
* External Agencies (Government, Banking, Agents, etc.)
* Third party service providers


**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, or related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM (Finance, Operations, International Business) preferred.
* Additional certifications in Trade Finance, International Trade, Commercial Management, or Contract Management will be preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\-12 years of experience in Coal Trading, Commodities Trading, Mining, Energy, Metals, or Bulk Cargo industries.
* Proven experience in managing large\-value domestic and international trading transactions.
* Extensive exposure to commercial operations, contract management, LC operations, trade finance, documentation, logistics, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience handling multiple stakeholders including customers, suppliers, banks, legal teams, shipping lines, customs authorities, and government agencies.
